name: fp8-optimized
hypothesis: The already-correctness-tested optimized FP8 products reduce update time versus the saved BF16 KS3 trial, allowing more of the unchanged PR393 schedule within the accepted raw-weight control budget. First convergence test of this implementation.
cap_rule: Stop before starting an update if current elapsed plus 1.05 times the maximum of the last four observed stage update durations plus setup reserve reaches the exact budget. Setup remains on the original timer. Report any actual overrun; strict qualification has no tolerance.
preserved: Original full PR393 MoE8 top1 router, non-KS3 blocks, CPLM, global update sizes over eight logical ranks, objective schedule, optimizer settings and FP8 formats. Full 24-update warmup restored before continuous training. Raw full validation, no canonical mask, no final window extension, no tail shipping.
